verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents an official MCP server that AI assistants can connect to. Its scope is limited to searching public docs and the live OpenAPI spec: it never proxies API calls and never sees credentials. An agent can connect, but it can only get help writing integration code, not act on tax data, nexus, filings or transactions. Missing for 10: MCP tools that execute Kintsugi API operations, authenticated agent access to account data, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server.
